emphasis.text: Coverage centres on the police investigation of Markle Sr and Meghan's reaction.
Some outlets focus on the son's role and the alleged content of the images.

summary.text: Thomas Markle Sr, the estranged father of the Duchess of Sussex, is under police investigation, reported to be in the Philippines, over allegations by his son Thomas Jr that he possessed child sex abuse images. Meghan said she is "deeply distressed" and was made aware of allegations in 2018.

conclusion.text: All outlets report a police investigation into Thomas Markle Sr over child abuse image allegations. Left and centre outlets lead with Meghan's distress and her 2018 awareness, while right-leaning outlets focus on the son's accusations, Markle Sr's denial and the alleged images.
